headline: Uzbekistan Exports Surge 33% to $25.7 Billion in First Ten Months of 2026
summary: Uzbek exports increased 33% year-on-year to $25.7 billion between January and October 2026. Foreign direct investments and loans attracted reached $49.5 billion over the same period.
why: Uzbekistan is Central Asia's most populous country, undergoing market reforms to boost foreign trade and WTO accession.

impacts.name: Uzbekistan
impacts.why: Surging exports and foreign investment inflow strengthen Uzbekistan's economic performance.
